# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

basedir <- here("species/crob/bulk/ARCA123/KY21")
genomedir <- here("species/crob/genome/KY21")

source(here(basedir, "code/utilities_ggplot.R"))
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tpm <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/03_compiled/tpm_no-testis.csv"))
uss <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/03_compiled/uss_intestine.csv"))

samples <- read_csv(here(basedir, "data/00_metadata/samples.csv")) |> 
  filter(tissue_short != "S")
tissue_order <- c("I1", "I2", "I3", "I4")
samples <- mutate(samples, tissue_short = fct(tissue_short, tissue_order))

genes <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/gene-display-names.tsv"))
display_names <- deframe(select(genes, gene_id, display_name))
```


# PCA on intestine samples

```{r}
pca_int <- uss %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp()

pca_int_var <- summary(pca_int)[[6]][2, ] * 100
pca_int_x <- pca_int$x %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("tissue_name") %>% 
  right_join(x = samples, y = ., by = "tissue_name")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 6
plot(pca_int_var, xlab = "PC", ylab = "% Variance Explained")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 6

ggplot(pca_int_x, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_label(mapping = aes(label = tissue_short, fill = colour)) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw_2()

ggplot(pca_int_x, aes(PC3, PC4)) +
  geom_label(mapping = aes(label = tissue_short, fill = colour)) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw_2()
```

It doesn't look like there is any PC that's perfectly and strongly correlated with anterior-posterior axis. 

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 9

plot_pc_against_segment <- function(x, .pc) {
  ggplot(x, aes(tissue_short, .data[[.pc]],  fill = colour)) + 
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    theme_bw_2()
}

wrap_plots(
  map(1:12, ~ plot_pc_against_segment(pca_int_x, paste0("PC", .x)))
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 9

plot_pc_against_rin <- function(x, .pc) {
  ggplot(x, aes(RIN, .data[[.pc]], fill = colour)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    theme_bw_2()
}

wrap_plots(map(1:12, ~ plot_pc_against_rin(pca_int_x, paste0("PC", .x)))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8
plot_top_loading_genes <- function(x, .pc, .n = 10) {
  x$rotation %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% 
    select(all_of(c("gene_id", .pc))) %>% 
    mutate(direction = ifelse(.data[[.pc]] > 0, "pos", "neg")) %>% 
    nest(.by = direction) %>% 
    mutate(data = map(data,
                      ~ .x %>% 
                        slice_max(abs(.data[[.pc]]), n = .n))) %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(data)) %>% 
    arrange(.data[[.pc]]) %>% 
    mutate(gene_id = fct_inorder(gene_id)) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey") +
    geom_point(aes(.data[[.pc]], gene_id)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = .data[[.pc]], y = gene_id, yend = gene_id)) +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right", 
                     labels = function(y) str_trunc(display_names[y], 72)) +
    labs(x = "Loading", title = .pc) +
    theme_bw_2() 
}

plot_top_loading_genes(pca_int, "PC1", 20)
plot_top_loading_genes(pca_int, "PC2", 20)
plot_top_loading_genes(pca_int, "PC3", 20)
plot_top_loading_genes(pca_int, "PC4", 20)
```
